info.title: CF Meet Platform API — communications
info.description: Personal communications identity, contacts, privacy and (Sections 9-23) unified Chats, Calls, Contacts, Meetings and Settings facades. Existing Account authentication is authoritative. Calling, Messaging and Meetings remain the owners of calls, messages and meetings; these operations are authorized facades, per-user preferences and read models. No phone OTP or phone-number discovery. Internal policy, principal, lifecycle and operator APIs are private and excluded. 1.3.0 (final closure): phone verification and phone recovery report the canonical PROVIDER_BLOCKED (was DEFERRED), the label the account profile uses. 1.5.0: POST /api/v2/communications/calls/{callId}/participants adds connected personal contacts to a running call by contact id. 1.6.0: privacy groupInvitationPolicy (who may add the person to groups), independent of contactRequestPermissions. CommonGroup.title and MediaItem.fileName document that they are null for PRIVATE_E2EE conversations by design.
